# Sub-Head: 02_Earth_Work

[2.1.1] Earth work in surface excavation not exceeding 30 cm in depth but exceeding 1.5 m in width as well as 10 sqm on plan including getting out and disposal of excavated earth upto 50 m and lift upto 1.5 m, as directed by Engineer-in- Charge: All kinds of soil
  Resource: [0114] Beldar (Labour)

  Derivation: 100.0 sqm / 6.8000 worker-days = 14.71 sqm/worker-day (1.84 sqm/hr across 8h shift)
  Evidence: CPWD DAR 2019 Item 2.1.1
